description_en: Retrieves the real-time network status of a mobile phone number, such as active, shutdown, or non-existent. You can query numbers that are in plaintext or hashed using MD5 or SHA256
description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi phone-number-status-for-account --auth-code Dd1r0004id --input-number 13900001234 --mask NORMAL --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PhoneNumberStatusForAccount

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

On the My Applications page in the Phone Number Intelligence console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply), obtain the authorization ID. This ID is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

在号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)我的申请页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en:
The phone number to query.

If `Mask` is set to `NORMAL`, this parameter is an 11-digit mobile phone number.

If `Mask` is set to `MD5`, this parameter is a 32-character hashed string.

If `Mask` is set to `SHA256`, this parameter is a 64-character hashed string.

If `Mask` is set to `SM3`, this parameter is a 64-character hashed string.

<notice>

The letters in the hashed string are case-insensitive.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的号码。

若Mask取值为NORMAL，该字段为11位手机号码。
若Mask取值为MD5，该字段为32位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SHA256，该字段为64位加密字符串。
若Mask取值为SM3，该字段为64位加密字符串。

<notice>加密字符串中字母不区分大小写。 ></notice>
parameters.name: input_number

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:

NORMAL: The number is not encrypted.

MD5

SHA256

SM3
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式。取值：

NORMAL：不加密
MD5
SHA256
SM3
parameters.name: mask

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

OK: The request was successful.

OperatorLimit: The query is prohibited by the carrier.

RequestFrequencyLimit: Carriers restrict frequent queries for the same number within a short period. If you receive this error code, try again later
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：

OK：成功。
OperatorLimit：运营商禁止查询的手机号。
RequestFrequencyLimit：因运营商限制，禁止在短时间内高频对同一个号码进行反复查询，如返回此错误码，请您稍后再试

Carrier.description_en:
The number's current carrier. If the number has been ported to a new carrier through mobile number portability, the new carrier is returned. Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile

CUCC: China Unicom

CTCC: China Telecom

Queries for China Broadnet numbers are not supported
Carrier.description_zh:
号码当前归属的基础运营商。如果查询的号码存在携号转网，则返回携号转网后的基础运营商。取值：

CMCC：中国移动。
CUCC：中国联通。
CTCC：中国电信。
暂不支持中国广电的号码查询

Status.description_en:
The status of the phone number. Valid values:

NORMAL: The number is active.

SHUTDOWN: The number is suspended or temporarily out of service.

POWER_OFF: The phone is powered off.

NOT_EXIST: The number is non-existent.

DEFECT: The number is invalid.

UNKNOWN: The status is unknown.

Due to adjustments in the carrier's system, China Telecom numbers do not return the `busy` and `powered off` statuses. For more information, see the official announcement (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2489709.html)
Status.description_zh:
检测手机号返回状态。取值：

NORMAL：正常。
SHUTDOWN：停机。
POWER_OFF：关机。
NOT_EXIST：空号。
DEFECT：异常号码。
UNKNOWN：未知。

因运营商系统调整，中国电信的号码不支持返回：忙、关机状态。 详见官网公告 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2489709.html)

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is unique to each request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求返回的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
